UserHousehold.title: UserHousehold
UserHousehold.description: Authenticated user's household profile, onboarding name, and budget calibration.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

userName.description: Preferred first name used by Maa and home greeting (1-60 chars).

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the user has finished Ghar onboarding calibration.

fixedCommitmentsPaise.description: Fixed monthly commitments (rent, bills, EMIs) in paise.

monthStartDay.description: Day of month when salary/allowance cycle resets (1-31).

habitLeaks.description: Bounded list (max 10) of calibrated spending leak habit names.

lifeStage.description: Life stage label (Salaried, Student, Freelancer / Self-Employed, Homemaker / Other).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Household khata transaction entry (debit or credit) owned by a user.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

direction.description: Whether money left (DEBIT) or entered (CREDIT) the batua.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the transaction occurred.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SavingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
SavingsGoal.description: Papa's clay Gullak savings goal owned by a user.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

currentAmountPaise.description: Current accumulated Gullak balance in paise.

targetDateEpochMillis.description: Optional target date in epoch milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

MaaChatMessage.title: MaaChatMessage
MaaChatMessage.description: Immutable kitchen chat turn between the user and Maa.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

sender.description: Author of the message in the Rasoi chat.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PapaChatMessage.title: PapaChatMessage
PapaChatMessage.description: Immutable study-room chat turn between the user and Papa regarding savings, investments, and grounded financial insights.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

sender.description: Author of the message in Papa's study chat.

sourcesJson.description: Optional serialized JSON array of Google Search grounding web citations (0-4000 chars).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

QuickChip.title: QuickChip
QuickChip.description: User-customized one-tap household expense or income stamp chip.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

label.description: Short stamp label shown on the chip (1-24 chars).

merchant.description: Khata note or merchant description recorded when tapped (1-120 chars).

category.description: Household category assigned when logging via this chip.

direction.description: Whether this stamp logs an expense (DEBIT) or income (CREDIT).

colorKey.description: Pastel linen color wash of the quick stamp.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChitthiNote.title: ChitthiNote
ChitthiNote.description: Handwritten note or motherly/fatherly wisdom stashed by the user into their Chitthi Dabba.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

author.description: Whether the stashed note came from Maa or Papa (BHAI retained for legacy compatibility).

title.description: Short header on the sticky note (1-80 chars).

body.description: Handwritten wisdom or advice text (1-1000 chars).

tag.description: Category tag of the note (1-40 chars).

savedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the note was stashed.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PakkaCommitment.title: PakkaCommitment
PakkaCommitment.description: Recurring monthly household commitment (bill, payment/EMI, subscription, or incoming receivable) owned by a user.

userId.description: Denormalized owner UID matching parent /users/{userId} and request.auth.uid.

title.description: Commitment title such as Electricity Bill, Netflix, Rent, or Freelance Retainer (1-80 chars).

amountPaise.description: Expected monthly commitment amount in paise (> 0).

type.description: Commitment classification: BILL, PAYMENT, SUBSCRIPTION (outflows) or RECEIVABLE (inflow).

category.description: Ledger category used when settling this commitment.

dueDayOfMonth.description: Day of the calendar month when due or expected (1-31).

notes.description: Optional memo or account reference (0-240 chars).

isActive.description: Whether this monthly commitment is active in the current cycle.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp; clients MUST submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Root per-user household profile, onboarding name, and budget calibration.

/users/{userId}/transactions/{transactio.description: User's private household khata ledger entries.

/users/{userId}/goals/{goalId}.description: User's private clay Gullak savings goals.

/users/{userId}/maa_chats/{messageId}.description: User's private conversation history with Maa.

/users/{userId}/papa_chats/{messageId}.description: User's private savings and investment conversation history with Papa.

/users/{userId}/quick_chips/{chipId}.description: User's customizable quick expense and income Khata stamps.

/users/{userId}/chitthis/{chitthiId}.description: User's stashed handwritten Chitthi notes from Maa and Papa.

/users/{userId}/pakke_commitments/{commi.description: User's recurring monthly bills, fixed payments, subscriptions, and receivables.
